name: Instructor
author: 567-labs
one_liner: Gets typed, validated data out of an LLM using Pydantic models, and retries with the error message when validation fails.

loop.proposes: a structured answer (JSON) from a hosted or local LLM
loop.judged_by: Pydantic validation of types and any custom validators you write
loop.steers: on a failed check, the validation error is sent back to the model and the call is retried

not_proved: Passing validation shows the data fits the schema and your rules, not that it is true. Retries cost extra model calls and may still end in failure.
